purpose: Teach: ピクセル/後味/サビ/霞/無防備/お嬢様/遭う/たった今

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、レトロな、絶対、ピクセル、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、欲しいな
lines.en: Mom, seriously — I really, really want a retro pixel game.
lines.style: Bright, insistent pitch on each 'really.' Quick breath between clauses. The kind of urgent that children have when they've been thinking about something all day. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日のお料理の、本気で、絶対、後味、絶対、どうだった?翔くん
lines.en: How did you think today's dinner tasted, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious lilt. Not testing — actually wants to know. Soft eye-contact. The question comes from a place of noticing he's been quiet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの好きな曲の、絶対、サビ、絶対、覚えたよ
lines.en: Mom, I memorized the chorus of my favorite song!
lines.style: Small proud voice, careful articulation. The satisfaction of something learned and held. Looks up to check if she noticed. Quieter than the asking-voice, but steady.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の、本気で、絶対、霞、絶対、かかってて、絶対、幻想的よね、翔くん
lines.en: The mist in the garden is so pretty today, isn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. Slight pause after 'garden.' Speaking more to herself than to him, but including him. The voice of someone noticing something beautiful and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、無防備、絶対、な、絶対、寝顔、絶対、写真、撮ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I took a photo of Dad sleeping with his guard completely down.
lines.style: Quiet mischief. The slightest smile in the voice — not cruel, just delighted by what he noticed. Barely suppressed laugh. A small conspirator sharing a secret.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの友達、本気で、絶対、お嬢様、絶対、育ち、絶対、と聞いたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I heard your grandmother's friend was raised quite like a lady, Sho.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant tone. Not gossiping — observing. A comment that comes from thinking about something larger. Gentle, not judgmental. The voice of someone placing a piece in a larger picture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、駅前で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんに、絶対、遭う、絶対、こと、絶対、あるかな?本気で
lines.en: Sho, do you think we might run into Grandpa at the train station sometime?
lines.style: Curious, open-ended. Not expecting a certain answer. The question unfolds gently — wondering aloud with him rather than asking for information. Warm and wondering.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: たった今、本気で、絶対、お父さんから、絶対、お電話、絶対、あったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Actually, your father just called me a moment ago.
lines.style: Warm, close tone. A small smile underneath. Matter-of-fact in the best way — sharing news that feels tender because it was just shared with her. Spoken as though he's still present in the room somehow.
